name: Maid Gari
source:
Main character wins the main prize of "Maid mania" challenge and gets 100 hours together with cute maids in a mansion. is living in a mansion with four maids. But his attitude was so cruel that maids tried to escape the mansion. He caught them, locked in a room and continued his play.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在“女仆狂热者”挑战中赢得头奖，可以在宅邸里与可爱的女仆共度一百小时。他和四名女仆住在一起，但态度过于残酷，女仆们试图逃离宅邸。他抓回她们，锁进房间，继续自己的游戏。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
